examples.label: Authenticated directory traversal to list/read arbitrary paths

notes: Needs valid admin creds (pair it with the manager brute-force). Read outside the web root (e.g. --dir / then descend) to pull configuration.php DB creds or system files.

recommended.note: Provides the admin login this exploit needs.
Escalate the same admin access to full RCE.

name: Joomla - Authenticated Directory Traversal (CVE-2019-10945)
description: Authenticated directory-traversal in the Joomla Media Manager (CVE-2019-10945) that lists and reads files outside the web root using valid admin credentials.

defense.why_it_works: Joomla com_media directory traversal passes a user-controlled path parameter to file-reading functions without normalization, allowing traversal outside the media root to read arbitrary files including configuration.php.
defense.prerequisites: Vulnerable Joomla version. HTTP access to the admin panel. Admin credentials for authenticated variants.
defense.impact: Read of configuration.php reveals plaintext database credentials enabling direct database access and full site takeover.
defense.detection: GET/POST requests containing directory traversal sequences (../../) to Joomla admin endpoints. WAF alert for path traversal patterns.
defense.artifacts: Web server access log (traversal sequences in URL parameters) | WAF path traversal alerts
defense.prevention: Keep Joomla core and all extensions fully patched. Use realpath() and validate the resolved path starts with the expected base directory. Set open_basedir.
defense.misconfiguration: Vulnerable Joomla version processes user-supplied path parameters without realpath() normalization, and open_basedir is not configured.
